about.desc: An AI sales team that runs on your computer: finding, qualifying and profiling overseas customers, then reaching out and following up — done by cooperating AI agents.
about.oss_sub: This software uses the following permissively licensed components
about.p1: Local only: leads, profiles, logins and API keys never leave your PC
about.p2: Quality first: the AI never lowers the bar to hit a number
about.p3: Safe defaults: risky features are off; enabling needs confirmation and is logged
about.p4: Quality control: Analyst grading + hard program checks + spot checks; mark “Not a good fit” in the lead library and the AI improves
about.p5: Evidence-based: every AI conclusion links to its sources
about.step: This version includes: ideal-customer templates, lead tasks (Google / web / YouTube / TG groups), the Monitor, the Analyst, the lead library and daily push.
about.title: About

decider.hint_llm: No extra key needed, but costs more than a dedicated decision model.

grp.assisted_sub: Paste group links (one per line). With assisted joining on, the app joins them slowly, spread across accounts, within each account's daily limit. When it's off, links wait in the queue — you can join them yourself in Telegram and then click “Sync groups”.

grp.joined_hint: Groups switched on are read while a task is running (tick "TG groups" when creating a task; {iv}). The first round reads the last 7 days; after that only new messages.
grp.queue_hint: Each account joins only a few groups a day at random intervals to avoid Telegram restrictions.
grp.sub: While a task runs, the Monitor reads new messages in these groups and picks out real buying requests. Each account manages up to about 500 groups.
grp.title: Telegram groups
grp2.assistedOn: Assisted joining is on: the app joins these groups slowly, spread across accounts.
guide.search_body: The free search often hits search engines' bot checks, so finding customers is unreliable. A Serper or Brave key (free tiers available) in Settings → Search keys is much more reliable.

icp.chat_empty: e.g. “Remove retailers, add contractors” or “Also add the Nordic countries”
icp.chat_ph: e.g. Remove retailers, add engineering contractors

icp.delete_confirm: Delete “{name}”? Its learning samples are deleted too; leads already found are kept.

icp3.aiHint: Generated by AI from your material (used by the Monitor's pre-filter and the Analyst's grading); tell the AI in the chat on the right to change them.
icp3.chatHint: e.g. remove one customer type, add another
icp3.chatIntro: Your template is ready. Tell me what to change, e.g. “remove one customer type” or “only customers in one country”.
icp3.countryHint: Tell us the target countries in the follow-up interview or in the chat below; if you don't, leads are not filtered by country.
icp3.notYet: Not yet — generated from the template before the first prospecting run
lead.deal_saved: Marked as won — the AI will learn from it as a high-weight good example
lead.dnc_body: Its website, emails, Telegram and WhatsApp go on the blacklist: it's excluded automatically whenever it shows up again and the Sales Rep will never contact it. You can undo this any time.
lead.qualified_sub: Meets the hard conditions (the target countries and customer types you gave), grade, uniqueness, has a Telegram username or explicit WhatsApp and verifiable sources. Goes to sales in today's push.
lead.sources_sub: Every statement comes from these pages
leads.delete_confirm: Delete {n} lead(s)? This cannot be undone.
leads.empty: The library is empty. Start a prospecting task to fill it.
leads.title: Lead library
leads2.emptyFirstSub: Tell the Sales Manager what customers you want, or start a lead task under "Tasks" on the left.
leads2.sub: {total} in total, {qualified} qualified; every lead has source evidence
learn.big_change: This is a bigger rule change — it takes effect only after you confirm
learn.center_sub: The AI learns from your feedback in the lead library (not a good fit / deal / 👍). Big rule changes wait for your confirmation, and you can roll back to an older version at any time.
learn.curve_sub: Approved ÷ (approved + rejected); “later” is not counted. Higher means the AI understands you better.
learn.dm_fallback: Decision model accuracy too low — temporarily using the big model: {r}
learn.dm_tests_sub: Tests the decision model on examples you gave feedback on; if accuracy drops it switches back to the big model automatically
learn.embed_started: Download started — you can keep working
learn.embed_sub: Judges on your computer whether a message resembles your good examples — no API cost
learn.empty_sub: Mark leads “Not a good fit”, “Deal” or 👍 in the lead library and examples appear here.
learn.good: Good example (this is what I want)
learn.no_data: Not enough data yet — the curve appears after a few days of pushes
learn.nothing_pending_sub: When the AI learns an important new rule or notes a request from your chats, it waits here for your confirmation.
learn.rollback_body: Later versions are marked “rolled back” and the AI switches to the older version right away. Leads and examples are not deleted.
learn.save_first: Save the profile first; then add samples here or use 👍 / 👎 in the lead library.
learn.sub: Good 👍 and bad 👎 examples you teach the AI. The Analyst looks at the most relevant ones when scoring.
learn.text_ph: Paste a buying request, a company description, etc.
learn.title: AI learning samples
learn.types_sub: What the AI learned about which group messages are buying requests
learn.versions_sub: Every change is a new version you can roll back
learn2.noQuality: No leads pushed yet — the curve appears after a few days of pushes
learn2.qualitySub: Weekly, for leads pushed to sales: the lower the “Not a good fit” rate and the higher the deal rate, the better the AI understands you.
learn2.spotSub: A share of the leads the Analyst qualifies is double-checked by another model; the share rises automatically when “Not a good fit” goes up. Leads that fail go to the backup pool and are not pushed.

qs.agree.h1: The app runs on your computer
qs.agree.h2: The AI can make mistakes — you make the important decisions

qs.agree.h5: AI costs are charged by your API
qs.agree.p1: Customer data, leads, chats and all keys stay on this computer only (keys and logins encrypted). Only when calling AI models, searching and visiting web pages is the necessary content sent to the API and websites you chose.
qs.agree.p2: Information and grades from the AI are for reference only. Qualified leads are pushed to your sales team every day; if one is not a good fit, mark it in the lead library and the AI improves.
qs.agree.p4: Features such as automatic group joining or reading pages after login can get accounts restricted. You confirm the risk before turning them on; the confirmation is logged on this computer and you bear the consequences.
qs.agree.p5: Model and search costs are charged directly by the platform your key belongs to. The app keeps spending within your total budget and pauses when it's used up.

ev.monitor_round_start: Reading a round of TG groups
ev.monitor_task_round: TG round: {chats} groups, {messages} messages, {hits} buying requests; next round per the monitoring frequency
ev.task_tg_waiting: TG groups: {n} groups are being watched, read per the monitoring frequency ({iv}); buying requests go to this task, which keeps running until it reaches the target or you stop it
sch.hint.now: Starts now and runs until it reaches the target or 23:59 today.
sch.hint.once: Starts once at that time (this computer's time) and runs until the target or 23:59 that day. If the computer is asleep or off then, it catches up once when it's back on that day.
sch.hint.daily: Starts a run every day at that time (this computer's time); the target is per day. Each run lasts until the target or 23:59. A missed run catches up once when the computer is back on that day.
sch.title: Scheduled / daily
sch.targetDailyHint: Daily target: each run stops once it has this many qualified leads
sch.delBody: No more automatic runs. Past runs stay in the task list. A run that is going now isn't affected (you can stop it separately).
run3.sub: Create tasks (now / scheduled / daily) and see every task's progress; click a task for its live progress
wb3.startHint: Start one under "Tasks" on the left
grp4.needTaskText: TG groups are read only while a task runs: create a task under "Tasks" on the left and tick "TG groups"
ev.task_day_end: Reached the end of the day (23:59); this run stops
alert.schedule_failed.title: A scheduled / daily task couldn't start
alert.schedule_failed.action: Fix it, then start a task manually under "Tasks" on the left; tomorrow's run will try again
icp4.wordsHint: AI generates them in Chinese / English / Malay from your product; edit freely. Words you add are translated into the other languages when you save. A message or page goes to AI only if it has a buy word or product word and no exclude word
icp4.buyPh: Ways people say they want to buy; Enter to add
icp4.prodPh: Product names and aliases; Enter to add
icp4.exwPh: Words that rule a message out; Enter to add
icp4.emptyHint: No lead words yet: AI generates them from the product description when you save
learn2.aiWordsSub: Words AI learned from leads you approved and added automatically (read-only). Undo if they're wrong; edit your own words under "Templates" on the left.
learn2.aiExclSub: Exclusions AI added after you marked leads "not good" (competitors, existing customers) (read-only). Undo if wrong; edit under "Templates" on the left.
learn2.samplesWhere: Add / delete them under "Templates" on the left
grp5.batchOnDone: Watching {n} groups (read once a task starts)
grp5.allFiltered: Nothing is ticked: this applies to all {n} groups in the list now.
grp5.monOn: Added to monitoring (read once a task starts)
grp5.monitorUnconfigured: The Monitor has no model configured: watched groups won't be read. Configure it in Settings → AI models.
grp5.monitorOff: The Monitor is switched off: watched groups won't be read. Switch it on in its card on the Workbench.
ev.page_no_words: No buy word or product word on this page; skipped (no AI cost): {url}
ev.no_lead_words: The template has no lead words (buy / product words) to build search queries from: add them under "Templates" on the left
c.unsavedBody: If you leave now, these changes are lost.
board.shortfall2: Not enough this time: the current sources ran out.
srcnote.google.search_blocked: Google search: the free search was stopped by a bot check (a Serper or Brave key in Settings → Search keys makes it much more reliable)
srcnote.google.search_key_invalid: Google search: the search key is wrong (fix it in Settings → Search keys)
srcnote.google.search_quota: Google search: the search key has no quota left (change it in Settings → Search keys)
srcnote.web.no_urls_blocked: Web crawler: no URLs given, and the automatic directory search was blocked too
srcnote.youtube.youtube_key_missing: YouTube: no YouTube key (add it in Settings → Search keys)
ev.search_query_failed: Search for "{query}" didn't work ({error}); moving on to the next one
errors.decision_bad_format: This model can't answer choice questions in the required format; try another one
price.srcHint.reference: This model's API gives no price, so costs use the built-in official reference price (updated with the app); you can enter your own price in this AI's settings
price.srcHint.estimate: No price found for this model, so costs use a deliberately high estimate and the budget still applies; you can enter your own price in this AI's settings
price.mineHint: Only fill this in if you want the budget to use your own price; otherwise the API's price, the reference price or the estimate is used. Now: {now}
set3.saveWhy: Nothing to save unless you enter your own API, change the backup model or the price
set3.allSame: Use the Manager's API for unconfigured AIs ({n})
set3.allSameDone: {n} AIs now use the Manager's API (models picked by rule)
set3.keysSub: A Serper or Brave key makes Google search much more reliable (the free search often hits bot checks); YouTube needs a YouTube key. Changes save right away.
tasks4.ytNoKey: Add a YouTube key in Settings → Search keys first
tasks4.freeSearch: Using the free search, which often hits bot checks; a Serper or Brave key in Settings → Search keys is much more reliable
ch2.readonly: This view only shows how many leads each channel brought. Switch TG group monitoring under "TG groups"; AI group finding is under "AI group suggestions".
mem.workTech: Work data the AI can see (technical)
alert.high_intent_round.title: {n} high-intent buyers found this round
wb3.cfgWhere: Configure it in Settings → AI models
pause.readySub: See the AI cards below for current work status.
pause.stopTitle: Stop current work and pause new tasks?
pause.stopBody: Running prospecting, monitoring and lead-pool tasks will stop; results are kept. An in-flight call may still need to finish. Resuming allows new tasks but does not restart stopped tasks.
company.title: Company profile
company.name: Company name
company.editHint: Correct the company details prepared by the AI. Saved details are used by the team; unsaved edits can be discarded.
company.productsHint: One product line per line; up to 50 lines and 200 characters per line.
company.productsLimit: Use at most 50 product lines, with up to 200 characters per line.
company.profileDone: Your profile is confirmed and active.
company.profilePending: Your profile is not confirmed. Continue in Settings → Restart setup.
company.modelsDone: A model plan has been applied. Check each AI in Settings → AI models.
company.modelsPending: A model plan has not been applied. Check and configure the required AIs in Settings → AI models.
company.nextStep: When ready, start prospecting from Tasks in the sidebar. Ask the Manager if you need help.
chat.clearBody: Clear all chat history with {name}? Saved memos will remain. Replies already being generated will not return to the conversation. This cannot be undone.
chat.forgetBody: Clear chat history and all memos owned by {name}? Shared memos for all AIs will remain; clear them together in the memory center. Profiles, leads, source pools, learning samples and account settings will remain. This cannot be undone; old replies already being generated will be discarded.
chat.forgetAllBody: Clear every AI conversation and all memos, including shared memos? Profiles, leads, source pools, learning samples, prompt edits and account settings will remain. This cannot be undone; old chat replies already being generated will be discarded. Running collection tasks will continue.
errors.chat_cleared: The conversation was cleared and the old reply discarded. Please send again.
